title: Structure-based computational prioritization of Emodin-8-glucoside as a candidate ligand for the VEGFR1 kinase domain in the context of placenta previa.
authors: Inan, Deniz; Karagecili, Sinan; Ali, Nouman
one_liner_zh: 该文针对胎盘前置相关VEGFR1激酶结构域，采用对接、MD和DFT等计算流程筛选候选配体，属于蛋白质-配体结构计算应用，但对象为激酶域而非蛋白结构方法创新，故评7分。
abstract: Placenta previa is a serious obstetric condition associated with abnormal placental implantation and hemorrhagic complications, for which no targeted pharmacological therapy is established. This study applied an integrated structure-based computational workflow to explore the intracellular VEGFR1 kinase domain as a candidate molecular target. Twenty-one phytochemicals were screened using AutoDock Vina and MOE, with Emodin-8-glucoside consistently prioritized among the highest-ranked compounds. Redocking of the co-crystallized ligand 8ST reproduced its experimental pose with a heavy-atom RMSD of 1.465 A. Comparative 500 ns molecular dynamics simulations showed persistent binding-site association of Emodin-8-glucoside and the 8ST control. End-point energy estimates were method dependent, with MM-GBSA yielding a negative mean estimate while MM-PBSA yielded a near-zero estimate with substantial variability. DFT analysis produced a HOMO-LUMO gap of 0.13204 Hartree (approximately 3.59 eV). SwissADME and ProTox 3.0 identified low gastrointestinal absorption, P-glycoprotein substrate behavior, high polarity, and several predicted toxicity liabilities. Overall, Emodin-8-glucoside represents an in-silico-prioritized exploratory candidate requiring biochemical, selectivity, placental-cell, and pregnancy-safety validation.
abstract_zh: 前置胎盘是一种与胎盘异常植入和出血性并发症相关的严重产科疾病，目前尚无针对性的药物疗法。本研究采用整合的结构化计算工作流程，探索细胞内VEGFR1激酶结构域作为候选分子靶点。使用AutoDock Vina和MOE筛选了21种植物化学物质，其中Emodin-8-glucoside始终位列排名最高的化合物之中。共结晶配体8ST的重新对接重现了其实验构象，重原子RMSD为1.465 Å。比较性500 ns分子动力学模拟显示，Emodin-8-glucoside和8ST对照在结合位点持续关联。终点能量估计依赖于方法，MM-GBSA产生负的平均估计值，而MM-PBSA产生接近零的估计值且变异性较大。DFT分析得出HOMO-LUMO能隙为0.13204 Hartree（约3.59 eV）。SwissADME和ProTox 3.0识别出低胃肠道吸收、P-糖蛋白底物行为、高极性以及若干预测的毒性风险。总体而言，Emodin-8-glucoside代表一个经计算机模拟优先排序的探索性候选物，需进行生化、选择性、胎盘细胞和妊娠安全性验证。
